x_query.oql:
get works where published since 2020-01-01
  and title-abstract has (stemmed "distributed acoustic sensing" AND (stemmed "deep learning" OR stemmed "machine learning"))
  and published through 2025-12-31
  and type is ([article](article) or [review](review));
then, group those works by year
x_query.x_new_oql: get the count of works with (stemmed "distributed acoustic sensing" AND (stemmed "deep learning" OR stemmed "machine learning")) in the title or abstract where type is ([article](article) or [review](review)) by year from 2020-01-01 through 2025-12-31
